turns.assessment: The seven-week rise in transmit laser bias current is the defining signature of incipient transmit-laser ageing in trx.och209.a. Stable optical power, OSNR, pre-FEC BER, DGD, SOP rate, and all amplifier telemetry argue against a path, receiver, ROADM, or amplifier fault. There is no current service impact, but the trend can precede transmitter failure, so proactive maintenance or replacement should be scheduled before an end-of-life alarm or outage.

proposals.rationale: This documented fault mode directly produces rising transmit-laser bias current while the laser control loop maintains output and service performance. The unchanged downstream and path-quality measurements are consistent with an incipient, compensated ageing condition.
